title: One school's complete record (general admission + program track + shared lookups)

id.description: Must match the filename (data/schools/<id>.json) and be referenced consistently everywhere else (CDS7 keys, PROGVERIFIED's <id>_prog convention where applicable, etc.)

general.description: Everything the old inline SCHOOLS[] entry held: name, location, admit stats, cost, deadlines, judgment-call scores, links, etc.

program.description: The old PATHWAYS[] entry for this school's formal BS/MD or early-assurance program, if one exists. null = no formal program.

programVerified.description: Real sourced program stats consumed by progChance(): minGpa/minSat (published floor), avgGpa/avgSat (published average of admits), admitRatePct (real rate when published), src (source URL). NEVER fabricate a value here — leave the field null and let progChance() fall back to 'no data / see general admission' rather than inventing a number.

src.description: Required whenever any numeric field above is non-null.

cds7.description: Common Data Set Section C7 factor-weighting for this school, if a readable CDS was found.

accel.description: Old ACCEL[] entry: combined 6-7yr accelerated BS/MD (different concept from early-assurance program above).
